description: One link that connects or reconnects a channel. Send it to the user: it opens in any browser, needs no login with us, works for 3 days, can be sent on to whoever has the login, and finishes the connection by itself. Use when a channel is missing, or when get_connection_health says needs_reconnect.

forSomeoneElse.description: true when another person has the login: the answer is then worded for the user to send the link on to them

name: get_connect_link
title: Get Connect Link
